title: Codex Marketplace Manifest
description: Marketplace catalog read by Codex at .agents/plugins/marketplace.json, .agents/plugins/api_marketplace.json, .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, or .cursor-plugin/marketplace.json (first match wins). Authored from the OpenAI Codex source; OpenAI publishes no JSON Schema for this manifest.
$comment: Provenance: authored (not upstream-vendored) 2026-09-08. Sources: openai/codex codex-rs/core-plugins/src/marketplace.rs (MARKETPLACE_MANIFEST_RELATIVE_PATHS, raw structs), marketplace_tests.rs fixtures, installed_marketplaces.rs, marketplace_add/source.rs, and the bundled plugin-creator skill. There is no github source variant: the tagged enum has only Local, Url, GitSubdir, and Npm. Entry order is render order.

plugins.description: Ordered plugin entries; the order is the render order.

entry.description: Any plugin-manifest field may be inlined here as a flattened fallback used when the plugin source cannot be read.

name.description: Must match the folder name and the plugin.json name.

products.description: Product gating override; an empty array denies every product.

source.description: Where to fetch the plugin. A bare string is treated as a local relative path. The github variant is not supported.
